title: The Mirror City
text: You step through into a copy of the city you left, reversed and empty. The rift is a bright seam in the sky above it.

pass.text: You find the place where the two cities touch, and you stitch them apart.

fail.text: Your reflection follows you out, two steps behind.

title: A Garden of Teeth
text: Flowers turn to follow you, and every one has teeth.

pass.text: You hack a path to the rift's root and tear it out.

fail.text: You escape, bleeding from a dozen bites.

title: The Library Without Walls
text: Shelves of books stretch in every direction, under a sky of more books.

pass.text: You find the book that describes this rift, and the page that ends it.

fail.text: You read for what feels like years. When you step out, only an hour has passed.

title: The Endless Stair
text: A staircase spirals down through nothing. Far below, something breathes.

pass.text: You walk down without looking back, and lock the door at the bottom.

fail.text: You run back up for what feels like days.

title: The Bazaar of Lost Things
text: A market where everything ever lost is for sale. The merchants do not take money.

effects.prompt: Trade a piece of your mind for a relic?

then.text: The merchant wraps your purchase in a page of your own memories.

pass.text: You find the stall that sells doors, and you buy this one shut.

fail.text: A pickpocket with too many hands finds you first.

title: Under a Black Star
text: A black star hangs in a white sky. It is singing to you.

pass.text: You sing back, and the star goes quiet. You come home changed, and stronger.

fail.text: You listen to the whole song.

title: Your Own Echo
text: On the other side you meet yourself, older, coming back.

pass.text: Your older self tells you how to close it. You do not ask what else they know.

fail.text: You trade places for a little while. You do not remember what you did.

title: The Tide of Hands
text: The ground on the other side is a sea of grasping hands.

pass.text: You wade through them and pull the rift shut behind you.

title: The Singing Dark
text: Total darkness, full of voices singing one long chord.

pass.text: You learn the chord and sing it backward. The rift closes, and you keep the song.

fail.text: The chord gets into your head and stays there.

title: The Gatekeeper
text: Something guards the far side of the rift, and it does not want you to leave.

pass.text: With the guard out of the way, you close the gate.

fail.text: You escape, but the rift stays open.

title: A Voice Offers a Deal
text: A pleasant voice offers to close the rift for you. It only wants a small favor, later.

pass.text: The voice sulks as you close the rift without it.

title: Lost Between
text: You fall between worlds, and the way back keeps moving.

pass.text: You catch the edge of the rift and fold it shut as you climb out.

fail.text: You climb out somewhere else entirely, days later.
